tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Lists published items of EOL Watch: retirements, end of support dates and breaking changes. Filter by cloud, kind of change, category, service, search text and effective date. Without status it lists upcoming items only, soonest first. To list ended items, breaking changes in effect or every item, s

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Returns one published item in full: its dates, summary, impact, migration path, replacement, affected versions and sources, as Markdown and as structured data. Use it with the slug of a row that search_items returned; the address of the item page or its short address works too. An unknown slug is an

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists every service that has a published item, with its number of items, how many of them are upcoming and the date of the next one. Use it to find the slug of a service before you filter search_items by service, or to see what is tracked for one cloud.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Lists the infrastructure as code providers, tools and modules whose releases are read for breaking changes, each with its newest tracked release. Use it to find the key that get_provider_changes takes.

tools.name: get_provider_changes
tools.description: Returns what the page of one provider, tool or module shows: the range of releases that is tracked, the summary sentence, the notices and the breaking changes of each release that lists any. Send from with the version in use to get only the releases above it. Read the notices before you call a range

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Returns one page of the changelog of EOL Watch, newest first: items added, effective dates changed, items updated and items withdrawn. Use it to see what changed since you last read the data.
